stats: U2C1 housekeeping droids were manufactured by Publictechnic. The model had a bare humanoid frame cast from a blue hardened plastic and was equipped with a Wire Brush attachment and a vacuum attachment. The droid did not have a personality matrix, because Publictechnic chose to eschew a streamlined frame personality matrix to achieve a more cost effective line.

The Watchman is a small enclosed patrol cloud car, built by Ubrikkian, a large manufacturer of planetary vehicles, including best-selling designs in the cloud car market. The Watchman is a typical patrol cloud car, used on many worlds to maintain order. It is a popular design throughout the Galaxy and rich citizens of the Galaxy tend to purchase this vehicle to use it as a pleasure craft.

The Kohr-Ah Marauder is a very powerful vessel rivaling the Ur-Quan Dreadnought. It is armed with spinning sawblades and a destructive F.R.I.E.D. system. The ship has been described as being ominously black, as dark as space, with an alien script carved upon the hull producing a "crusty" appearance.

The Uumufalh was an escort starship used by the Yuuzhan Vong to accompany large warships. 120 meters long and spear-shaped, they were gunships, equipped with dovin basals and plasma cannons, along with coralskippers. They were made out of reddish-black yorik coral. The Sacred Pyre was one such ship.

The Utwig Jugger is one of the most dangerous ships in our region of space thanks to its unique weapons and shield system. During the events of Star Control II, this ship design fares very well in large-scale warfare against the Ur-Quan Kohr-Ah, inflicting grievous casualties on the Kohr-Ah fleet before the Utwig themselves sustain too many losses to continue, withdrawing back to their space.

An Ur-Quan captain can also send out pairs of small, one-man fighters armed with lasers to harass the enemy. A swarm of these can team up to puncture an enemy ship's hull in seconds. Each fighter has only a limited supply of life support and fuel and must return to the Dreadnought after its brief sortie. Fighters are not affected by gravity.
